title: The Lamentable Later Life of Lemmings
summary: This appears to be an editorial/blog post analyzing the decline of the Lemmings video game franchise, discussing how later installments failed to live up to the beloved original 1991 game. The article is from filfre.net, a well-known gaming and tech blog that often covers retro gaming topics with critical depth.
problem_solved: Explores why the Lemmings franchise lost its appeal and quality over successive releases.
